topic: Frozen shoulder: just wait it out?
caption:
Struggling to lift your arm or reach behind you? 🙆
Frozen shoulder moves through stages, so the right approach changes over time.

Gentle, regular movement within comfort is the foundation. Get assessed to match your exercises to your stage.
